## Appendix

This website is built with [Quarto](https://quarto.org/).

### How to view the website locally

Download Quarto from [here](https://quarto.org/docs/download/) to use the `quarto` command. Then, just run:

```sh
$ cd path/to/this/directory
$ quarto preview
```
